toxic_foods: Chocolate contains theobromine, which is toxic to dogs and cats causing heart and neurological issues.
Grapes and raisins can cause acute kidney failure in dogs.
Onions and garlic contain thiosulfate, which damages red blood cells and causes anemia.
vaccination_guidelines: Puppies and kittens require core vaccinations (Rabies, DHPP/FVRCP) starting at 6-8 weeks of age.
Adult pets need booster shots annually or every 3 years depending on local laws and vaccine type.
emergency_signs: Difficulty breathing, pale gums, sudden collapse, or ingestion of known toxins require immediate veterinary emergency care.
